note: Every figure the website states about insurance. None carries a date or a source on the website, so asOf is null for all of them.

facts.statement: Medical inflation in India is about 14% a year.
facts.asOfNote: Date not stated on the website
facts.note: A market statistic. The website gives no source, year or definition (which costs, which cities).

facts.statement: The average ICU bill is about ₹12 lakh.
facts.asOfNote: Date not stated on the website

facts.statement: Look for a claim settlement ratio of 99% or more.

sources.quote: Look for 99%+ CSR for 3 consecutive years.

facts.asOfNote: Date not stated on the website
facts.note: Guidance, not a measured figure. The website names no insurer, source or year, and does not say whether the ratio is by number of claims or by amount.

facts.statement: A critical illness plan covers 30 or more listed illnesses.

sources.quote: Covering 30+ major bugs in the human hardware.

facts.asOfNote: Date not stated on the website

facts.statement: A major surgery costing ₹5 lakh today is shown as ₹9.6 lakh in 5 years and ₹18.5 lakh in 10 years.
facts.asOfNote: Date not stated on the website
facts.note: An illustration of 14% a year growth (5 x 1.14^5 = 9.6, 5 x 1.14^10 = 18.5). Not a forecast of any hospital price.
